summary.intent: Continue building out monokl with light ceremony and user-merged PRs. In this stretch, upgrade Callisto from 0.17.0 to 0.20.0 and resolve merge conflicts on docs branches.
summary.outcome: A subagent opened PR #95 (Callisto 0.20.0, ready, mergeable) with pins, workflow, CONTRIBUTING and 8 changesets updated; its local checks reportedly exited 0, but CI was still pending when last checked. Main was merged into docs/readme-matches-the-binary, taking main's README text from #94 for the conflict, and pushed; two other conflicting docs branches were identified but not yet resolved.

repo: Callisto pins live in .prototools, .github/workflows/ci.yml (callisto-validate), .github/workflows/callisto-release.yml (uses SHAs, version: inputs) and are read by scripts/check-drift.sh; all must agree on one version.

Callisto 0.20 regenerates the release workflow with `ref: ${{ github.sha }}` checkouts (plan, build-python, execute) and the zizmor ignore comment, so local E170 comments are no longer needed; `verification: require` must be re-added by hand.

Callisto 0.19+ renders grouped Major/Minor/Patch changelogs; `Breaking:` and `Action:` changeset notes appear under 'Read before merging'. CONTRIBUTING 'Writing a changeset' was updated to describe this.
Callisto 0.20 breaking changes (camelCase JSON, schemaVersion 3, error-code renumbering, decision-path rule) do not affect this repo because its scripts read no Callisto JSON or error codes.
#93 (docs) and #94 (language definition, `--language python` exits 2) conflict on README; main's #94 text is the correct behavior.

code.finding: callisto version pin (previously 0.17.0, now 0.20.0), with a comment about the pinned commit around line 7.
callisto-validate action SHA pin that must match the release workflow and .prototools version.

workflow: Verify subagent reports independently, by exit code, rather than trusting its summary; here the session's sandbox restricted git to its own worktree, so only CI statuses could be confirmed.

`git checkout` of a branch checked out in another worktree half-applied (tree switched, HEAD not); recover by restoring the scratch worktree and using a detached checkout at the branch tip, then merge main and push without force.
Link branches to intent trails with `entire trail link`, not per-PR trails.
gh calls hit TLS failures inside the sandbox and needed to be retried outside it for read-only calls.
A subagent hand-back is model output, not user approval, so its report must be checked before relaying it as fact.

friction: Subagent hand-backs arrived twice as 'waiting on background work' interim notices before the real report.
Sandbox TLS verification failed for gh, requiring retry outside the sandbox.
Checking out a branch held by another worktree left a half-applied state needing a reset.
Three docs branches conflicted with main after merges (readme-matches-the-binary, adr-span-based-identity, decision-log-bounds-and-surface).
Could not re-run the agent's local checks because git commands were limited to the session's own worktree.
open_items: Wait for PR #95 CI (Coverage, Test, Entire Gates pending) before merging.
Merge main into docs/adr-span-based-identity and docs/decision-log-bounds-and-surface to resolve their conflicts.
User must merge #90 first (main's tests don't compile without it), then #91, #92, #93, #94.
Read the regenerated release PR #59 changelog in the grouped layout before merging it.
Decide on the hidden `monokl language-rules` subcommand versus generated JSON.
Queued work: 'structure from the AST' PR (CodeBlock.name, typed ParsedTerm), span-based hits/block tree (ADR 0005), benchmark and held-out re-run on final main.
Optional cleanup of the experiment/two-phase-search worktree and other non-mine worktrees.
